Enrichment moves 2026-10-06 (zcode:enrich-mytheme-l3), per scene:
#0 python — the pre-emblem world: repel + shove pointer (Python's terror, the boast's contest), turbulence 0.15; Cupid carries an attract force (the intervention foreshadowed); the games' ring sequence walks oak → 'no laurel yet' → oak — the absence the ending will fill, named in the record's own words. Duration 12.
#1 arrows — the contrary charges staged as opposed flights: the golden arrow flies from the left toward Apollo, the leaden from the right toward Daphne, both shrinking as they strike; Peneus's disc becomes 'granted' — the yielded permission as a word. Vortex + pulse pointer (the crossing charges). Duration 11 — the sharpest beat, the wounding.
#2 pursuit — THE 3D SCENE. z is the chase's depth: Apollo nearest (z +0.45, breath reaching her hair), Daphne ahead (z +0.05) with her own position sequence fleeing across the field, hound and hare behind (z −0.2), the self-listing (z −0.3) and the failed self-cure deepest (z −0.45); auto-chase, a sine LFO on speed — the pace that changes while the pursuit stays. Repel + shove at 0.55, the hardest pointer in the journey. Duration 14.
#3 tree — near-still field (speed 0.3, dispersion 0.04) — the transformation holds everything still while it happens; attract + implode pointer (the reaching hand, the embrace); the pursued sequence walks Daphne → bark→branches → laurel; the heart's sequence beats quick (1.6s/1.4s holds — the fastest cadence in the journey) under the ⤫ that keeps the record's exact quotation. Duration 13.
#4 laurel — line layout: the procession — laurel, Capitol, doorposts in series; the laurel triangle greens then gilds (the offices acquired); the nod sequence runs ↘ grey → ↘ gold (recoil, then seeming assent, neither cancelling the other); vortex + pulse pointer (the emblem entering circulation). Duration 12.
#5→0 return — ring layout: the emblem's history held in the round; attract at 0.2, the gentlest hold; the A20 seam walked 'A20' → valuation→possession → 'A20'; the ♡ re-brightens inside the emblem's history — the recoil retained in the reading. Duration 15, the longest beat.
ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: the journey opens with oak crowns and 'no laurel yet' — honour before the emblem exists — and closes holding that emblem in the round with its acquired history attached: the record's own closing line, returning to the first leaves awarded after Python's defeat and encountering the laurel with pursuit, exhaustion, heart and recoil still in it. The Cupid attract force foreshadowed at #0 answers as the heart that keeps beating at #3 and the recoil retained at #5→0; the arrows' opposed flights (#1) are the asymmetry the two accountings name; the nod's gold at #4 never cancels the recoil's grey — the ending that would disappear if the last lines were cut away is kept visible on purpose.
Human-amplified staging: the kicker carries the ratified seam's flag (A20, A27 human-amplified: yes); the craft note keeps appropriation named as Taylor's judgment with Ovid supplying the event and its tension. Mythemic verbs only: the images demonstrate pursuit, transformation and appropriation through the acts staged; no universal meanings distributed to serpent, river and tree.
Automation: auto-chase (#2, field.params.speed sine — the pace that changes while the pursuit stays), tied to the record's own A31 comparison. Durations 11–15 and transitions 1.2–2.2: the wounding sharpest, the return held longest; the heart's 1.4–1.6s holds the fastest cadence.

glyph_rationales.Apollo: at #0 the victor over Python claiming the bow's martial office; at #2 the pursuer whose prophecy, medicine and song cannot secure Daphne's desire.
glyph_rationales.Cupid: the retaliatory archer — his two arrows give the pursuit its asymmetry before Apollo knows he is in it.
glyph_rationales.no laurel yet: the games' oak crowns — the honour that exists before the emblem; the absence the ending's history will fill.
glyph_rationales.→: the arrows — golden exciting love, leaden driving it away; one retaliatory intervention, opposite charges in two bodies.
glyph_rationales.Daphne: at #1 the woodland life with refused suitors and Phoebe her model; at #2 the pursued; at #3 the pursued become tree.
glyph_rationales.granted: Peneus's yielded permission — the request for perpetual virginity accepted before any pursuit; a participant's act, not a generic river.
glyph_rationales.⚕: Apollo's self-listing — Delphi, Claros, Tenedos, Patara, Jupiter's son; competence substantial, jurisdiction limited.
glyph_rationales.✕: the failed self-cure — another arrow has wounded him more surely; his healing art cannot cure its master.
glyph_rationales.◌◌: the Gallic hound and hare — hunter seeks prey, hare seeks safety; the specified difference between their aims.
glyph_rationales.♡: the beating heart under the fresh bark — life and resistance retained in the changed body; at #5→0 the heart inside the emblem's history.
glyph_rationales.⤫: 'even the wood shrank from his kisses' (1.556) — the recoil's exact witness, quoted in the record's own words.
glyph_rationales.✧: her radiance remaining in the changed form.
glyph_rationales.bark→branches: the transformation's conversions — heaviness, bark, foliage, branches, roots; each altering a capacity the chase had used or threatened.
glyph_rationales.laurel: the leaf-crown — the changed form that will carry the public office.
glyph_rationales.≤≥: Augustus's doorposts — the civic honour flanking the oak; the emblem's extension into political life.
glyph_rationales.↘: the nod after the recoil — the seeming assent retained with the recoil, neither moment cancelling the other.
glyph_rationales.A20: image, valuation and possession — competent distinction become possession; the ratified return route.
glyph_rationales.valuation→possession: the seam the record names — how the valued image begins to dictate the terms on which its living source is admitted.
glyph_rationales.A27: self and other without possession — another can appear in my world without becoming mine to complete.
